description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Canfield Scientific is hiring an Associate Systems Test Engineer to test software applications across its commercial products. The role supports senior engineers through manual and automated testing, defect reporting, and maintenance of testing tools and procedures.
Associate Systems Test Engineer supporting product and device testing through manual regression/performance tests, automation scripting, and defect reporting

Responsibilities:
• Assist with front and back-end testing across all products and devices, supporting senior engineers
• Work collectively with senior team members to solve defects and suggest improvements
• Execute manual test scripts for installation, integration, performance/stress, and regression testing
• Maintain existing automation tools/testing procedures to support testing efforts
• Contribute to automation testing, including hands on scripting, with internal frameworks
• Maintain strong project management skills ensuring all steps of designated projects are completed
• Communicate with senior developers any defects that arise when completing manual or automation testing

Requirements:
• The ideal candidate will be detail oriented, have a strong understanding of the software testing life cycle, and work with multiple applications and projects
• The right candidate is one who performs productively in a fast-paced work environment, works efficiently on multiple projects simultaneously, possesses strong communication skills, and has a proven track record of handling repetitive tasks
• Bachelor's degree
• Experienced with unit, functional, performance, installation, compatibility, end-to-end/system, integration, and regression testing
• Proficient with C#, Python, Java, SQL
• Knowledgeable of automation tools (Ranorex, Selenium, Appium, Squish, Playwright)
• Skillful at installing and configuring Windows/Mac on a PC/Hardware and mobile devices

Preferred:
• preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Technology
• Experience testing medical devices and graphics/imaging software
